title: Miscellaneous data-set and run options
purpose: Exercises a group of per-data-set and global options of the `epsr` engine of EPSR [@soper1996,@soper2005] that a user commonly adjusts: Q limits, background-subtraction radius, data scaling, energy weighting of data sets, resolution, the R-space coefficient and the input Q scale [@epsrmanual].
system: The EPSR-test system: a liquid mixture of 200 dimethyl sulphoxide (DMSO, (CH3)2SO) and 400 water molecules (DMSO mole fraction 1/3; 3200 atoms) at 300 K in a cubic box of side 33.12 Å (atomic number density 0.0881 atoms/Å³). DMSO uses EPSR's Lennard-Jones + Coulomb reference potential with methyl rotational groups; water uses SPC/E Lennard-Jones and charge parameters [@berendsen1987] with EPSR's flexible intramolecular geometry (O-H 0.976 Å). The empirical potential is refined against three neutron diffraction data sets of deuterated DMSO in D2O, in null-scattering H2O/D2O and in H2O (ISIS SANDALS runs SLS03863, SLS03871, SLS03850), the isotope-substitution approach of Soper and Luzar [@soperluzar1992]. For this case data set 3 gets zero weight in the empirical potential (`efilereq` 0) and the three data sets are scaled by 1.03, 1.0 and 0.97.
inputs: Only the `.EPSR.inp` differs from EPSR-test (`scripts/make_inp.sh` via `scripts/setkw.py`): `qmin 0.60 0.80`; `rshmin` 0.5 / 0.9 / 1.1; `tweak` 1.03 / 1.0 / 0.97; `efilereq` 1.0 / 0.5 / 0.0; `fwhm 0.03`; `rspcrmin 1.50`; `rspcfrac 0.3`; `qinscalefc 0.98 0.5`.
verification: Evidence from the README: qminm = 0.60 raises `nqmin` from 8 to 13; the log reports minimum radius integers of the potential 19 / 33 / 39 from `rshmin`; `efacm = efilereq/mean(nonzero efilereq)` scales the data-set rows of the inversion matrix, which is recalculated whenever `efacm` changes; `rspcrmin`/`rspcfrac` change the R-space coefficient and the `.erg` trend line.
notes: `qinscalefc 0.98 0.5` has a first value < 1, so coarse graining stays off: the values are only read and written back (`selfbroadpwr` is only used with coarse graining).
